files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A vegetable box by weight: produce tiles (picture, name, price per kg, a weight field in kg named after the
  item) beside the box card with a meter of how full the box is, the total and the order button. Axes: layout
  (split, stacked), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

export type VeggieBoxProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  dishes: Dish[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: FoodLabels;
  fill?: number;
  total: number;
  currency: string;
  layout?: "split" | "stacked";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import Label from "../compose/Label.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Meter from "../compose/Meter.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import NumberField from "../components/number-field.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  dishes,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  fill = 60,
  total,
  currency,
  layout = "split",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<VeggieBoxProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="package" :title="empty" />
    <Box v-else class="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <Box
        :class="
          (layout as string) === 'split' ? 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3 lg:col-span-2'
          : 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3 lg:col-span-3 lg:grid-cols-6'
        "
        data-slot="items"
      >
        <Stack
          v-for="d in dishes"
          :key="d.id"
          gap="2"
          class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
          data-slot="item"
        >
          <MediaFrame :alt="d.name" ratio="1/1" />
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ d.name }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tpl(labels.perKg, fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)) }}
          </Text>
          <NumberField
            value="1"
            :name="tpl('{0}-kg-{1}', id, d.id)"
            min="0"
            :label="tpl(labels.weightOf, d.name)"
            :decrease="tpl(labels.decreaseOf, d.name)"
            :increase="tpl(labels.increaseOf, d.name)"
          />
        </Stack>
      </Box>
      <Stack
        gap="4"
        :class="
          (layout as string) === 'split' ? 'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6 lg:sticky lg:top-8'
          : 'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6 lg:col-span-3'
        "
        data-slot="summary"
      >
        <Text size="lg" weight="semibold">
          {{ labels.summary }}
        </Text>
        <Label :for="tpl('{0}-fill', id)" class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {{ labels.boxFill }}
        </Label>
        <Meter :value="fill" :min="0" :max="100" :id="tpl('{0}-fill', id)" />
        <Group gap="2" align="baseline" justify="between">
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ labels.total }}
          </Text>
          <Inline class="text-2xl font-bold" role="status" aria-live="polite" data-slot="total">
            {{ fmtMoney(total, currency) }}
          </Inline>
        </Group>
        <Button variant="default" size="lg" type="button" class="w-full">
          <LucideIcon name="shopping-bag" :size="16" />
          {{ labels.order }}
        </Button>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
